description: Scholarship recognizes effort in school: good or improving grades, exploring education and careers, a note on your conduct and service, teamwork in school activities, and reflecting on how school prepares you for the future.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Your grades
requirements.summary: Showing a strong average for a term, or improvement over the previous period.

requirements.title: Education and careers
requirements.summary: Two options, such as visiting an educational place or interviewing professionals about their training.

requirements.title: A note on your conduct
requirements.summary: A note from a school official, or a parent if homeschooled, about your behavior, leadership and service.

requirements.title: Teamwork
requirements.summary: One option: a school activity and what it taught you about teamwork, or a team project.

requirements.title: A written report
requirements.summary: A short report on how school will help your future or your career interests.
